Our love of the Innocenti and Piaggio brands drives everything we do, and we put equal amounts of care and attention into every transaction. We are probably the UK’s largest importer of hand-picked, direct from Italy, Lambretta scooters for restoration – Always managing to rediscover and unearth unique low-mileage and rare specimens. Please call us to discuss your requirements. New deliveries of approximately 45 machines every 3 months. So don’t hesitate to call we’re always happy to help! A b o u t U s About Us Get to know Parrspeed Scooters Here at Parrspeed Scooters, we have been established since the late Eighties, but our experience in both Lambretta and Vespa Scooters began in the late 70’s. My own love of Lambretta and Vespa Scooters started in 1978 with my first LI 125, obviously with mirrors and the usual ‘mod’ image. It later progressed to a genuine AF Extra ‘S’ Type Dealer Metalflake Special which was supplied by Arthur Francis when they were based at Watford. Since then I have owned and ridden many different types of Scooter, but mainly 60s/70s and 80s Dealer Specials, both genuine and replicas.
